card.name: Punctuation inside calcium channel blocker lists
card.fires_on: Commas, "including", "of" and "e.g." that come right before the next calcium channel blocker name (nifedipine, nisoldipine, felodipine, verapamil) in drug-interaction text.

modes.label: Comma in a list
modes.description: A comma after one calcium channel blocker, just before the next one is named.
modes.example: Calcium channel blockers Nifedipine, nimodipine<<,>> nisoldipine, verap

modes.label: Lead-in word
modes.description: A linking word such as "including" or "of" that introduces calcium channel blocker names.

card.plain: It fires at the commas and small words that sit between names in a list of calcium channel blocker drugs.
